name: Mount Karthala
subtitle: Karthala is an active shield volcano east of Moroni that makes up most of Grande Comore.

facts.label: Size of the volcano
facts.value: About two-thirds of the island; summit caldera of 4 x 3 km

facts.label: 1858 lava flow
facts.value: A flow of 13 km reached the west coast near Moroni

parts.text: Karthala is an active shield volcano east of Moroni that makes up most of Grande Comore. Its eruptions have at times sent lava close to the capital.
